title: Chicken Souvlaki
subtitle: Marinated chicken skewers with lemon and oregano
excerpt: Chicken breast marinated in lemon, olive oil, garlic and dried oregano, then threaded onto skewers and cooked over high heat. The marinade is simple and takes 15 minutes to prepare; the chicken benefits from at least 30 minutes of marinating time, though an hour is better. Serve in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato and red onion.
sourceNotes: Souvlaki, from the Greek word for skewer, has been eaten in Greece since ancient times; the modern street-food version became embedded in Greek culture after the 20th-century mass production of pita bread and portable grills.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate the chicken for up to 4 hours in the fridge for a deeper, more tender result.

content.text: You will need 8 skewers. Metal skewers are ideal; if using wooden ones, soak them in cold water for 30 minutes before threading to prevent them charring. Cook the skewers on a hot griddle pan, a grill, or in a very hot oven on the baking tray. A griddle pan over a high heat gives the closest result to an outdoor grill and produces nicely charred marks on the chicken.

items.prepNote: 1 juiced for marinade, 1 cut into wedges to serve

content.text: Combine the olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, crushed garlic, dried oregano, cumin, sweet paprika and a generous pinch of salt in a bowl. Add the chicken cubes and toss to coat. Cover and leave to marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours in the fridge.

Thread the chicken onto 8 skewers, pressing the pieces close together so they stay moist during cooking. If using wooden skewers, make sure they have been soaked in cold water for at least 30 minutes first.

To cook on a griddle pan: heat a griddle pan over a very high heat until smoking. Cook the skewers for 4 to 5 minutes per side until charred in places and cooked through. To cook in the oven: place on a baking tray in a 220C (fan 200C) oven for 18 to 20 minutes, turning once.
Rest the skewers for 3 minutes before serving. The internal temperature should read 75C. Serve with lemon wedges, warm pita bread and tzatziki if you have it.

items.cause: Overcooked, or breast was cut too small so it dried out at high heat
items.fix: Cut pieces no smaller than 3cm and check the internal temperature; pull from the heat at exactly 75C. Next time marinate overnight in the fridge for more moisture.

items.symptom: No char forming on the griddle
items.cause: Pan was not hot enough or skewers were moved too early
items.fix: Heat the griddle until it is visibly smoking before adding the skewers. Leave them undisturbed for at least 3 minutes before turning.
